title: How Many Parameters Does Forecasting Need? A Survey and Code-Level Audit of Lightweight Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.30685v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term time series forecasting supports decisions in energy, transportation, weather and finance, where forecasts are produced continuously and often on constrained hardware. Recent work has moved in two directions. One scales Transformers and pre-trained foundation models to millions or hundreds of millions of parameters. The other shows that models with only hundreds to tens of thousands of parameters remain competitive on the standard benchmarks. Existing surveys organize forecasting models by backbone and treat efficiency as a side topic, so the reasons these small models work, and the way their sizes are reported, remain unexamined. This survey focuses on lightweight long-term forecasting. It provides a taxonomy of about thirty-five models in six families, with a common notation and an architecture diagram for each core model. It offers a structured-linear view in which the smallest models are linear maps restricted by frequency

translated_title: 预测需要多少参数？轻量级长期时间序列预测的综述与代码级审计
translated_abstract: 长期时间序列预测为能源、交通、气象和金融等领域的决策提供支持，这些场景下预测需要持续产出，且往往运行在资源受限的硬件上。近期的研究沿两个方向发展：一个方向是将Transformer和预训练基础模型扩展至数百万甚至数亿参数规模；另一个方向则表明，仅有数百到数万参数的模型在标准基准上仍具有竞争力。现有的综述通常按骨干网络来组织预测模型，并将效率问题视为次要话题，因此这些小模型之所以有效的原因，以及它们参数规模的报告方式，一直未得到深入检视。本综述聚焦于轻量级长期预测，提供了涵盖六大家族、约35个模型的分类体系，采用统一的符号表示，并为每个核心模型给出架构图。它提出了一种结构化线性视角，在该视角下，最小的模型可被理解为受频率约束的线性映射……
tldr: 该综述系统梳理了六大家族约35个轻量级长期时间序列预测模型，并通过代码级审计揭示这些小模型为何有效以及其参数规模的真实报告方式。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically reviews about 35 lightweight long-term time series forecasting models across six families and conducts a code-level audit to explain why tiny models remain competitive and how their parameter counts are actually reported.
